VOLPAM SP01 Electric Scooter, 500W Powerful Motor, Max 27 Miles Range, Dual Suspension, 10” Pneumatic Tires, Max 21 MPH Speed, Dual Braking, Smart Control, Folding Commuting Electric Scooter Adults

– Powerful Performance: VOLPAM SP01 electric scooter equipped with a 500W brushless motor, provides strong acceleration and a max speed of 21 mph, making your daily commute efficient and effortless.

– Smooth Ride: Featuring 10 inches pneumatic tires and front and rear dual shock absorption system, this electric scooter ensures a stable and comfortable ride even on bumpy roads or rough terrains.

– Long Range Battery: With a 14.5AH battery , this scooter offers an impressive range of up to 27 miles on a single charge, letting you enjoy extended rides without frequent recharging.

– Smart Control: Easily monitor and customize your riding experience through the intelligent mobile APP control, allowing you to adjust scooter settings (lock/unlock, light on/off, gears, cruise control, etc..)

– Comfortable Wide Pedal: Constructed with high-quality materials, including a 6.7 inches wide pedal, our electric scooter combines durability, performance, and safety, offering a reliable and enjoyable riding experience.

Quality Warranty – The electric scooter has passed UL2272 certification test. VOLPAM pursues excellent performance and quality products for the users. 12-month or 180-day for different parts, please contact us if you have any questions
